lines.zh: 缓慢挪动着行尸走肉的身躯
lines.en: Slowly shuffling its rotting body

lines.zh: 低头咀嚼着腐烂的牙齿
lines.en: chomping with rotting teeth

lines.zh: 我一步挪半格，别催我。
lines.en: Half a block a step; do not rush me.

lines.zh: 腐臭的气息弥漫开来
lines.en: stench fills the air

lines.zh: 我一步挪半格，石板都磨响。
lines.en: Half a block a step, and the flagstones rasp.

lines.zh: 腐烂的肌肉在蠕动
lines.en: rotting muscles writhing

lines.zh: 缓慢地挥舞着腐烂的手臂
lines.en: slowly waving its rotting arms

lines.zh: 腐烂的手指勾勒着玩家
lines.en: rotting fingers reaching for the player

lines.zh: 一步三晃，才挪出半格。
lines.en: Three wobbles a step, half a block gained.

lines.zh: 拖着左脚，蹭过石板路。
lines.en: Dragging its left foot across the stone path.

lines.zh: 速度只有零点一七五。
lines.en: Its speed is only zero point one seven five.

lines.zh: 走三步，停两下。
lines.en: Three steps, two pauses.

lines.zh: 腐烂的皮肤下藏着恐怖的双眼
lines.en: rotting skin conceals terrifying eyes

lines.zh: 腐烂的手臂下垂，毫无生气
lines.en: rotting arms hanging down lifelessly

lines.zh: 腐烂的牙齿露出森森白骨
lines.en: rotting teeth revealing stark bones

lines.zh: 腐烂的皮肤松垮垮地挂在身上
lines.en: rotting skin hanging loosely on its body

lines.zh: 腐烂的肌肉松弛地垂下
lines.en: rotting muscles hanging slack

lines.zh: 腐烂的皮肤在风中飘动
lines.en: rotting skin flapping in the breeze

lines.zh: 腐烂的皮肤遮住视线
lines.en: rotting skin obstructing vision

lines.zh: 腐烂的手臂无意识地摆动
lines.en: rotting arms swinging aimlessly

lines.zh: 腐烂的牙齿间夹着泥土
lines.en: rotting teeth dirt between them

lines.zh: 腐烂的肌肉无力地抖动
lines.en: rotting muscles trembling weakly

lines.zh: 我歪着脖子，一直看你的方向。
lines.en: My head tilts, eyes fixed your way.

lines.zh: 用腐烂的双眼寻找玩家
lines.en: rotten eyes searching for the player

lines.zh: 腐烂的手臂指向玩家
lines.en: rotting arms pointing at the player

lines.zh: 腐烂的牙齿露出了獠牙
lines.en: rotten teeth baring fangs

lines.zh: 腐烂的皮肤紧绷着
lines.en: rotting skin tautening

lines.zh: 腐烂的手指指着玩家
lines.en: rotting fingers pointing at the player

lines.zh: 我走一步，要歇三下。
lines.en: One step, three rests.

lines.zh: 腐烂的牙齿在空中晃动
lines.en: rotten teeth swaying in the air

lines.zh: 腐烂的手臂挥动着
lines.en: rotting arms waving

lines.zh: 腐烂的皮肤紧贴着玩家
lines.en: rotting skin pressing against the player

lines.zh: 缓慢蠕动，疼痛难忍。
lines.en: SLOW... pain...

lines.zh: 伤口在腐烂，真疼。
lines.en: The rotting wound hurts...

lines.zh: 脚步声中带着痛苦。
lines.en: Slow... agony...

lines.zh: 腐烂的皮肉被撕裂。
lines.en: Rotten flesh tearing...

lines.zh: 缓慢挣扎，痛彻心扉。
lines.en: Slow agony...

lines.zh: 腐烂的速度让痛感加剧。
lines.en: The rotting speeds the pain...

lines.zh: 缓慢的痛苦无尽无休。
lines.en: Infinite slow torment...

lines.zh: 腐烂和疼痛交织的折磨。
lines.en: Rot and pain intertwine...

lines.zh: 缓慢地感受到痛苦。
lines.en: Slow agony...

lines.zh: 腐烂和痛苦交织的折磨。
lines.en: Rot and agony...

lines.zh: 你周围冒着绿光的腐肉让人难以抗拒。
lines.en: The glowing green flesh tempts you.

lines.zh: 你感到一股迟缓但致命的力量吸引着你。
lines.en: A sluggish but deadly force draws you in.

lines.zh: 腐烂的骨骼在你耳边低语，召唤你。
lines.en: Decaying bones whisper, summoning you.

lines.zh: 腐肉散发出的臭味勾起了你的食欲。
lines.en: The stench of rotten flesh piques your appetite.

lines.zh: 它慢慢地向你逼近，眼神中带着贪婪。
lines.en: It slowly stalks you, with greedy eyes.

lines.zh: 你看着它那缓慢但坚定的步伐。
lines.en: You watch its slow but determined pace.

lines.zh: 它发出微弱的绿色光芒，诱惑你。
lines.en: It emits a weak green glow, tempting you.

lines.zh: 它的叫声仿佛在邀请你。
lines.en: Its moan invites you.

lines.zh: 腐肉的气味在空气中弥漫。
lines.en: The smell of decay lingers in the air.

lines.zh: 它的眼睛闪烁着渴望的绿光。
lines.en: Its eyes glint with green desire.

lines.zh: 坚硬的骨头撞击发出沉闷的响声。
lines.en: Its hard bones make a dull thud.

lines.zh: 你撞上了它的坚硬躯体。
lines.en: You collide with its hard body.

lines.zh: 它的缓慢身躯与你碰撞。
lines.en: Its slow form collides with you.

lines.zh: 它的腐肉在你身上留下痕迹。
lines.en: Its decayed flesh marks you.

lines.zh: 骨头在你的盔甲上摩擦作响。
lines.en: Bones scrape against your armor.

lines.zh: 它的撞击让你感到不适。
lines.en: Its impact is unpleasant.

lines.zh: 你撞到了它的腐烂身体。
lines.en: You bumped into its decayed body.

lines.zh: 它的缓慢移动让你无法躲避。
lines.en: Its slow movement leaves you vulnerable.

lines.zh: 它的缓慢撞击让你难以招架。
lines.en: Its sluggish impact is hard to fend off.

lines.zh: 它的腐烂躯体与你相撞。
lines.en: Its decaying form collides with you.

lines.zh: 它慢慢地向伴侣靠近。
lines.en: It slowly approaches its mate.

lines.zh: 我拖着腿，慢慢绕着她转。
lines.en: I drag my leg and shuffle slowly around her.

lines.zh: 它的眼睛闪烁着对伴侣的渴望。
lines.en: Its eyes gleam with desire for its mate.

lines.zh: 它发出求偶的绿光。
lines.en: It emits a green mating glow.

lines.zh: 它那缓慢的舞步吸引了异性。
lines.en: Its slow dance attracts its mate.

lines.zh: 它慢慢爬向另一只僵尸。
lines.en: It slowly crawls towards another zombie.

lines.zh: 它那缓慢的步伐似乎在跳舞。
lines.en: Its slow pace seems like a dance.

lines.zh: 它试图用缓慢的身体触碰伴侣。
lines.en: It tries to touch its mate with its slow body.

lines.zh: 它的缓慢动作似乎在求偶。
lines.en: Its slow movements seem mating gestures.

lines.zh: 它那缓慢的姿态吸引着其他同类。
lines.en: Its slow posture draws other zombies.

lines.zh: 干枯的皮肤在风中摇曳。
lines.en: Dry skin flutters in the breeze.

lines.zh: 啃咬腐肉的声音令人生厌。
lines.en: The sound of gnawing on rotting flesh is revolting.

lines.zh: 摸索着寻找下一个目标。
lines.en: Reaches out for its next target.

lines.zh: 缓慢的行进中散发出腐臭味。
lines.en: Its slow progress emits an odor of decay.

lines.zh: 我用僵硬的指头摸索袋子。
lines.en: My stiff fingers fumble at the pouch.

lines.zh: 舔舐伤口，发出嘶嘶声。
lines.en: Licks its wounds, making hissing sounds.

lines.zh: 在腐烂的肉体中搜寻。
lines.en: Searches through the decaying flesh.

lines.zh: 腐肉腐败的味道弥漫开来。
lines.en: The smell of decaying flesh permeates the air.

lines.zh: 缓慢地爬行，寻找猎物。
lines.en: Slowly crawls, searching for prey.

lines.zh: 腐烂的手指轻轻敲击地面。
lines.en: Rotting fingers gently tap the ground.

lines.zh: 它缓慢地逼近。
lines.en: It slowly advances.

lines.zh: 我走得慢，但看得准。
lines.en: I walk slowly, but I see clearly.

lines.zh: 它伸出手指，触碰目标。
lines.en: It extends a finger, touching the target.

lines.zh: 它摸索着靠近，发出嘶嘶声。
lines.en: It reaches out, making hissing sounds.

lines.zh: 它的嘴张开，露出尖牙。
lines.en: Its mouth opens, revealing sharp teeth.

lines.zh: 它缓缓靠近，发出嘎吱声。
lines.en: It slowly approaches, creaking.

lines.zh: 我抬起手，指节还没伸直。
lines.en: I raise a hand whose knuckles won't straighten.

lines.zh: 它的触碰让人毛骨悚然。
lines.en: Its touch is disturbing.

lines.zh: 它缓缓地靠近，呼吸声沉重。
lines.en: It slowly approaches, its breathing heavy.

lines.zh: 它的眼睛盯着目标不放。
lines.en: Its eyes fixate on the target.

lines.zh: 它看见你了，可它走不快。
lines.en: It saw you, but it can't walk fast.

lines.zh: 它抬起手，指向你的方向。
lines.en: It raises a hand toward you.

lines.zh: 它的低吼慢了半拍。
lines.en: Its growl lags half a beat.

lines.zh: 你跑远了，它还在看你。
lines.en: You're far off; it's still watching.

lines.zh: 它认准了，就慢慢来。
lines.en: Once fixed on you, it takes its time.

lines.zh: 它的视线锁定在猎物上。
lines.en: Its gaze locks onto the prey.

lines.zh: 它开始瞄准，动作缓慢。
lines.en: It begins to aim, moving slowly.

lines.zh: 它的手指瞄准猎物，发出嘎吱声。
lines.en: Its fingers point at the prey, creaking.

lines.zh: 它的目光坚定，不会动摇。
lines.en: Its gaze is firm, unshakable.

lines.zh: 它用腐烂的手指瞄准。
lines.en: It aims with its rotting fingers.

lines.zh: 它的视线在猎物间游走。
lines.en: Its gaze roams over the prey.

lines.zh: 它缓慢地调整瞄准。
lines.en: It slowly adjusts its aim.

lines.zh: 我走得慢，可一直没停。
lines.en: I move slow, but I never stop.

lines.zh: 它瞄准猎物，发出嘶嘶声。
lines.en: It aims at the prey, making hissing sounds.

lines.zh: 它注视着目标，动作缓慢。
lines.en: It watches the target, moving slowly.

lines.zh: 它算不准距离，只能靠猜。
lines.en: It can't judge distance; it can only guess.

lines.zh: 它的眼睛在腐肉下转。
lines.en: Its eyes roll beneath the rotting flesh.

lines.zh: 它往前挪，一步都算数。
lines.en: It shuffles forward; every step counts.

lines.zh: 它张着嘴，等着走近。
lines.en: It holds its mouth open, waiting to get close.

lines.zh: 它不追，它等你回来。
lines.en: It doesn't chase; it waits for you to come back.

lines.zh: 它的手指抠着空气。
lines.en: Its fingers claw at empty air.

lines.zh: 它把重心往前压。
lines.en: It leans its weight forward.

lines.zh: 它盯着你的脚，不看脸。
lines.en: It stares at your feet, not your face.

lines.zh: 我张口，牙先掉了一颗。
lines.en: I open my mouth and a tooth falls out first.

lines.zh: 咕噜咕噜，唾液分泌中！
lines.en: Gurgle, saliva producing...

lines.zh: 啃咬，啃咬！
lines.en: Bite, bite!

lines.zh: 慢吞吞地靠近你！
lines.en: Creeping closer...

lines.zh: 我咬下去，指甲先抓到袖子。
lines.en: I bite down, but my nails catch your sleeve first.

lines.zh: 腐烂的牙齿磨擦！
lines.en: Rotting teeth grinding!

lines.zh: 嘶嘶，我饿！
lines.en: Sss, I'm hungry!

lines.zh: 缓慢而坚定地靠近！
lines.en: Slow and determined approach.

lines.zh: 慢条斯理地咀嚼！
lines.en: Chomping slowly...

lines.zh: 腐烂的指尖触碰你！
lines.en: Rotting fingertips touch you!

lines.zh: 它一巴掌拍在你背上，很轻。
lines.en: A slow swipe lands on your back, barely felt.

lines.zh: 它抓住你的袖子，扯不动。
lines.en: It grips your sleeve and can't pull.

lines.zh: 腐烂的指甲划过你的脖子。
lines.en: A rotting nail scrapes your neck.

lines.zh: 它咬下去，牙松了一颗。
lines.en: It bites down and loses a tooth.

lines.zh: 它推你，力气小得可笑。
lines.en: It shoves you with laughable force.

lines.zh: 它撞上来，自己先歪了。
lines.en: It stumbles into you and tips over first.

lines.zh: 腐土塌了一块，我才爬出来。
lines.en: A patch of rotten soil caves in before I crawl out.

lines.zh: 腐烂的土壤中诞生！
lines.en: Born from rotten soil!

lines.zh: 浅坑里先露出我的一只手。
lines.en: My hand comes out of the shallow grave first.

lines.zh: 腐烂的碎片中出现！
lines.en: Appearing from rot!

lines.zh: 嘶嘶，腐烂的气息！
lines.en: Sss, the stench of rot!

lines.zh: 腐烂的阴影中现身！
lines.en: Appearing from the shadow of rot!

lines.zh: 腐烂的泥土中诞生！
lines.en: Born from the rotten earth!

lines.zh: 腐烂的裂隙中出现！
lines.en: Appearing from the rotting fissure!

lines.zh: 泥地里，一只手先伸出来。
lines.en: In the mud, a hand comes up first.

lines.zh: 它从浅坑里慢慢坐起。
lines.en: It slowly sits up out of a shallow pit.

lines.zh: 腐土塌了一块，它爬出来。
lines.en: The rotten soil caves, and it crawls out.

lines.zh: 天黑了，它才磨蹭着起身。
lines.en: Only at nightfall does it lumber upright.

lines.zh: 它比别的僵尸慢半拍出现。
lines.en: It shows up half a beat later than other zombies.

lines.zh: 草叶间传来一声闷响。
lines.en: A muffled thud sounds among the grass.

lines.zh: 我走得慢，火却追得很快。
lines.en: I walk slow; fire does not.

lines.zh: 重重摔下，骨头作响。
lines.en: Fell hard... bones crack...

lines.zh: 水中腐烂更快。
lines.en: Rot faster in water...

lines.zh: 爆炸撕裂我的腐肉。
lines.en: Explosion tears my flesh...

lines.zh: 被投射物击中，疼痛难忍。
lines.en: Projectile hits... pain...

lines.zh: 魔法撕裂我的肉体。
lines.en: Magic tears my flesh...

lines.zh: 我把干瘪的肚子按住。
lines.en: I press my shriveled belly.

lines.zh: 雷电击中我，剧痛难当。
lines.en: Lightning strikes... pain...

lines.zh: 空虚之地，腐烂加速。
lines.en: Void accelerates rot...
